definitions.explanation: A sustained conflict or power struggle between groups. Often used for gang wars, political power struggles, or labor disputes. Composed of 抗 (resist) + 争 (contend). Implies organized, ongoing conflict rather than a single incident.

examples.japanese: ヤクザ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抗争|こうそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
{両派|りょうは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抗争|こうそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{激|はげ}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ま}した→増す：02422_masu⟧。
examples.english: The conflict between the two factions intensified.

examples.japanese: ⟦{労使|ろうし}→労使：27897_roushi⟧{抗争|こうそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ストライキ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発展|はってん}した→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧。
examples.english: The labor-management dispute escalated into a strike.

notes:
USAGE:
{抗争|こうそう} implies a serious, organized conflict between identifiable groups — not a personal argument. Most commonly associated with gang warfare and political power struggles in news reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抗争|こうそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧ (a conflict breaks out)
- {抗争|こうそう}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ (conflict incident — gang-related crime)
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧{抗争|こうそう} (power struggle)
- ⟦{労使|ろうし}→労使：27897_roushi⟧{抗争|こうそう} (labor-management dispute)
- ⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧{抗争|こうそう} (internal conflict)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{紛争|ふんそう}→紛争：05758_funsou⟧ (dispute, conflict) is broader and can include international conflicts. ⟦{闘争|とうそう}→闘争：14574_tousou⟧ (struggle, fight) often has ideological connotations (class struggle, labor struggle). {抗争|こうそう} tends to imply factional or gang-related violence.
